Stay safer online with top-performing VPN and much more. 

Get fast and reliable VPN with advanced privacy and malware protection plus parental control to keep your family and your devices safer online.  

Available products after install: 

Norton VPN Standard 
Protect your mobile online privacy when connected to Wi-Fi at home or while on-the-go. Norton VPN helps ensure private, fast internet access wherever you are. 
■ Change Location: Seamlessly connect to your ideal country and city so you can enjoy what you’re doing more securely, privately, and without interruption.
■ Content Access: Access your favorite shows, videos, and websites more privately around the world.
■ Auto Connect: Automatically turn on your VPN whenever you connect to a public network, so your data stays safer and more private.  
■ Tracker Blocker: Help block advertisers’ tracking technologies to reduce many of the targeted ads that follow you around the web. 
■ No-log policy (supported by 3rd party audit): We don’t track, log, or save your browsing activities. 
■ Global Servers: Our global high-speed VPN servers let you change your virtual location or you can auto-select the best region. Our servers dynamically scale with the number of users to ensure the best performance. 
■ Split Tunnelling: Encrypt, secure and anonymize the traffic you choose, without compromising streaming sites that may block VPNs or being subjected to bandwidth throttling during gaming. 
■ Kill Switch: If your VPN connection drops, you’ll be automatically disconnected from the Internet to help maintain your privacy. 
■ Compromised Network Detection: Choose to automatically secure your connection if you connect to suspicious Wi-Fi networks. 
■ Bank-grade Encryption: Stay anonymous online. 
■ Mobile widget: Allows you to control your VPN from the home screen without opening the app.
■ IP Rotation: Automatically change your IP address regularly to help prevent tracking, avoid targeted ads, and strengthen anonymity.
■ Double VPN: Route your traffic through two different VPN locations for even greater privacy and anonymity.
■ Pause VPN: Pause anytime, auto-resume seamlessly

Norton VPN Plus 
■ All features as Norton VPN Standard with additional: 
■ Malware Protection: Powerful protection against cyberthreats  
Get real-time protection against malware, phishing, ransomware, and other threats whether you’re using your devices online or offline. 
■ Dark web monitoring (Availability vary by country**): Be notified if we find your personal info on the dark web and take fast action to help secure your accounts and prevent it from being exploited. 
■ Password Manager: Create, store, and easily use strong passwords.
■ Cloud Backup (10 GB) 

Norton VPN Ultimate 
■ All features as Norton VPN Plus with additional: 
■ Privacy Monitor (US only): Take greater control of your privacy.  
Scan people-search websites to see if your personal info has been exposed and manually opt out from each of those websites to stay more private. 
■ Parental Control: Keep your children safer online  
■ Cloud Backup (50 GB) 

Even beyond encryption, Norton VPN is built by Gen Digital–a trusted leader in consumer cybersecurity. 

** Dark Web Monitoring disclaimer: § Dark Web Monitoring is not available in all countries. Monitored information varies based on country of residence or choice of plan. It defaults to monitor your email address and begins immediately. Sign in to your account to enter more information for monitoring. 

Norton VPN uses the Accessibility Service API to collect data about websites visited and apps viewed on Google Play.

Norton VPN requires All files access permission to properly run the App Security core feature.
